name: atlan
description: Atlan is the context layer for enterprise AI. Connect Claude to your organisation's context repos: the knowledge, data, and semantics your AI agents need to answer accurately. Use Atlan's agent skills to search and discover enterprise context, traverse end-to-end lineage, access governed data definitions and glossaries, execute SQL, curate your metadata graph, and ensure data quality, so every question you ask Claude is grounded in trusted organisational context.

_published_faq.name: How do I add atlan to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add atlan to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.atlan.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the atlan MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: atlan lists 32 MCP tools, including add_atlan_tags_tool, add_attributes_to_cm_set_tool, ask_tool, benchmark_query_tool, create_custom_metadata_set_tool, create_data_products, create_domains, create_dq_rules_tool, create_glossaries, create_glossary_categories, create_glossary_terms, and delete_custom_metadata_set_tool.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to atlan?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to atlan in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
atlan requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
atlan is developed by Atlan. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
